['Mr. Bea recounted the tale of a dream he had involving a forgotten suitcase.', 'Mr. Bea elaborated on the rain and his insights concerning an elusive stranger.', 'Mr. Bea discussed the stars and his memories of an abandoned village.', 'Mr. Bea narrated his experiences with the forest and his ideas about a hidden treasure.', 'Mr. Bea shared his reflections on the mountains and their connection to an ancient legend.', 'Mr. Bea spoke about the sea and his thoughts regarding a lost child.']

references: Mr. Bea spoke about the sea and his thoughts regarding a lost child.
